notes: Rakuten American Express Card (launched July 2025). Issued by First Electronic Bank pursuant to a license from American Express; powered by Imprint Payments. No annual fee. Cash Back is issued/redeemed via the cardholder's linked Rakuten account (not Membership Rewards). Earn rates and issuer verified against the official Rakuten rewards program terms page and PR Newswire launch release; the 4% Rakuten-purchase cap increased from $7,000 to $10,000 per calendar year effective July 15, 2026. Signup bonus reflects the $25/$500/90-day launch offer; some third parties report a later increased offer.
